entries.what: Indigenous Peoples' Day, no classes. Linh sleeps in, then works Monday at Heron & Grind from 3 to 9 closing, logging milk waste and locking the vault-room outlets.
entries.outcome: Closed on time and got home to a plate Hạnh left out.

entries.what: Between rushes she flips through her 600-card anatomy deck and updates the yellow list for the practical.
entries.outcome: Got through two chapters of cards on breaks.

entries.what: Rides her new e-bike home from Calle Ortega after close and charges it in the hallway.
entries.outcome: Battery at 40 percent, enough for tomorrow.

entries.what: Kenji gives her a ride to Tuesday chemistry at 11. Afterward she studies for the Oct 20 chemistry midterm.
entries.outcome: Finished a chapter of review problems.

entries.what: At 4 she attends Pedro's anatomy study group at the library, where he quizzes everyone with his 3D-printed bone models.
entries.outcome: Nailed the carpal bones.

entries.what: Annoyed that Beatrice docks the closers' tip jar for breakage, she drafts an email about it and asks whether she can just not send it. She doesn't send it.
entries.outcome: Draft saved, unsent.

entries.what: Anatomy at 9 with Dr. Okoye on the eve of midterm week. Rochelle sits beside her cracking jokes about the practical.
entries.outcome: Okoye reviewed what to expect on the lab practical.

entries.what: Checks the college portal and notes that spring priority registration opens Nov 18 at 7 a.m., then writes it in her planner with washi tape.
entries.outcome: Date circled for later.

entries.what: Closing shift at Heron & Grind, 3 to 9, with midterm students crowding the vault-wall outlets until close. Wes isn't there, but she hears the cortado regulars called 'Doc' jokes from Jun.
entries.outcome: Busy night, tips decent.

entries.what: Chemistry at 11, then a late-afternoon cram at the library the day before the practical. She skips lunch again.
entries.outcome: Color-coded the yellow list.

entries.what: The night before her own practical, she plans Thao's grocery list and a phở breakfast drop-off for Thao's night stretch.
entries.outcome: List sent, phở plan set for the morning.

entries.what: Bed at 12:30 with her dad's radio on the desk and a lo-fi playlist, going over cranial nerves one last time.
entries.outcome: Fell asleep mid-review.

entries.what: Takes Dr. Okoye's first lab practical at 9, the one a third of each section fails.
entries.outcome: Walked out unsure how it went.

entries.what: Meets Thao at Phở Bến Thành after her night shift. Thao mentions the Ridgeline IT lead and charting news among the hospital gossip.
entries.outcome: Ate a full bowl for once.

entries.what: Evening at home, Hạnh asks about pharmacy over dinner; Linh nods and changes the subject.
entries.outcome: The pharmacy talk is postponed again.

entries.what: Saturday opening shift at 6:30. Jun coaches her at the machine and she pours a clean rosetta; he moves her on to tulips. Beforehand she asked how to make hers symmetrical, and then mentioned his tulip.
entries.outcome: First clean rosetta, Jun says tulips next.

entries.what: Lumpia Saturday at the counter; Jun sells trays under Beatrice's 15 percent deal while Linh handles the espresso rush.
entries.outcome: Trays sold out by noon.

entries.what: Charges the e-bike behind the counter and rides home at 1 to nap.
entries.outcome: Slept two hours.

entries.what: Sunday cafe shift from 6:30 to 1, then a quick lunch from her prepped rice bowl.
entries.outcome: Sam covered the afternoon swap she was owed.

entries.what: Helps at the Lotus Nails front desk from 2 to 5 for Hạnh.
entries.outcome: Booked a week of appointments.

entries.what: Walks the Ulloa marsh boardwalk, then plans the week in her paper planner before the chemistry midterm on Monday at 8.
entries.outcome: Week mapped out with times.
